tweet.text:
Prefill/decode disaggregation creates a resource allocation problem: what happens when your GPU split no longer matches inference traffic?

Long prompts can saturate prefill workers while decode GPUs sit underutilized. Generation-heavy workloads can reverse that imbalance.

SGLang v0.5.21 adds runtime role switching. Once a worker drains to idle, an operator or router can call POST /pd_role_switch to change its role without restarting the server or reloading model weights.

The KV memory pool stays allocated while role-specific transfer structures are rebuilt. Rebalancing decisions still require external control logic.
